name: How long does damaged-board replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does damaged-board replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of damaged-board replacement varies depending on the extent of the damage, the number of boards needing replacement, and the accessibility of the area. Small repairs might take a few hours, while more extensive projects could span several days. We provide an estimated timeline after a thorough assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timing varies based on the damage extent and accessibility; small repairs take hours, larger projects several days.
